description:
Calculate min/max, mean and start-to-end change from Weirdgloop daily prices; this tool returns statistics, not a time series. For timestamped Jagex guide-price observations or UTC date bounds, call get_price_series instead. Use get_item_details for catalogue detail.
- Choose itemId to skip name resolution, or name to resolve first. days selects trailing usable samples from a fixed 90-day fetch; it does not change fetch size. Fewer available samples reduce windowDays.
- Return one aggregate: sample min/max, unweighted mean, newest-minus-oldest change and percentage relative to oldest. Volume averages exclude unreported values. There are no forecasts; no usable history is an error.
- Daily history lags live offers. No auth or local cache. Shared HTTP budget: 60 requests/IP/minute; retry 429 after Retry-After.

days.description: Size of the trailing window in days (7-90, default 30)

itemId.description: Grand Exchange item ID (provide itemId or name)

name: summarize_price_history

avgDailyVolume.description: Average daily volume rounded to a whole number, when the source provided it

avgPrice.description: Average price in the window, rounded to whole coins

changePct.description: Percent change across the window, rounded to two decimals; 0 when the oldest price is 0

latestPrice.description: Newest price in the window, in coins

maxPrice.description: Highest price in the window, in coins

minPrice.description: Lowest price in the window, in coins

name.description: Name supplied by the caller, when given

oldestPriceInWindow.description: Oldest price in the window, in coins

title: Summarize Daily Price Statistics
